prompt: A resistor has R = 100 ± 2 Ω and the current through it is I = 0.50 ± 0.01 A. Propagate the uncertainty to the power P = I²R, and show the method.
truth: P = 0.25 × 100 = 25 W. Relative uncertainties are 2% for R and 2% for I; I is squared so it contributes 4%. Assuming independent uncertainties combined in quadrature, the relative uncertainty is sqrt(0.04² + 0.02²) ≈ 4.5%, so P ≈ 25.0 ± 1.1 W. A worst-case linear sum would give 6% (± 1.5 W). A good answer shows the method and states the independence assumption (or says which combination rule it used).
